19	// machineEntry is one stop in the machine-filter ring: a stable key and its display label.
20	type machineEntry struct {
21		key   string // "" (all machines), "local" (this machine), or a remote deviceId
22		label string // "all machines", "local only", or a machineName (disambiguated if it collides)
23	}
24	
25	// rebuildMachineCycle derives the machine-filter ring from the current cloud rows. The ring is
26	// [all] until cloud rows from OTHER machines exist, at which point it becomes all → "local only" →
27	// each remote machine (keyed by stable deviceId, labelled by machineName, sorted by deviceId for
28	// stable order; duplicate names get (1)/(2) suffixes). This machine never appears as its own remote
29	// entry — it's covered by "local only".
30	func (m *sessionTUI) rebuildMachineCycle() {
31		// Latest machineName per remote deviceId, across whichever cloud rows are in play (browse's
32		// cloudAll and search's globalCloud).
33		names := map[string]string{}
34		addMachine := func(rows []sessionindex.Session) {
35			for _, s := range rows {
36				if !s.IsCloud || s.DeviceID == "" || s.DeviceID == m.deviceID {
37					continue
38				}
39				if s.MachineName != "" {
40					names[s.DeviceID] = s.MachineName
41				} else if _, ok := names[s.DeviceID]; !ok {
42					names[s.DeviceID] = shortID(s.DeviceID)
43				}
44			}
45		}
46		addMachine(m.cloudAll)
47		addMachine(m.globalCloud)
48	
49		if len(names) == 0 {
50			// No other machines to distinguish — the filter would be a no-op, so hide it.
51			m.machineCycle = []machineEntry{{key: "", label: "all machines"}}
52			m.machineFilter = ""
53			return
54		}
55	
56		ids := make([]string, 0, len(names))
57		for id := range names {
58			ids = append(ids, id)
59		}
60		sort.Strings(ids)
61	
62		// Disambiguate duplicate machine names with deterministic (1)/(2) suffixes.
63		labelCount := map[string]int{}
64		for _, id := range ids {
65			labelCount[names[id]]++
66		}
67		labelSeen := map[string]int{}
68	
69		cycle := []machineEntry{{key: "", label: "all machines"}, {key: "local", label: "local only"}}
70		for _, id := range ids {
71			label := names[id]
72			if labelCount[label] > 1 {
73				labelSeen[label]++
74				label = fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d)", label, labelSeen[label])
75			}
76			cycle = append(cycle, machineEntry{key: id, label: label})
77		}
78		m.machineCycle = cycle
79	
80		// If the active filter's machine dropped out of the ring, fall back to all.
81		if !machineKeyInCycle(cycle, m.machineFilter) {
82			m.machineFilter = ""
83		}
84	}
85	
86	func machineKeyInCycle(cycle []machineEntry, key string) bool {
87		for _, e := range cycle {
88			if e.key == key {
89				return true
90			}
91		}
92		return false
93	}

95	// cycleMachine advances the machine filter to the next ring entry and re-filters the cached rows
96	// client-side (no re-query), mirroring cycleAgent.
97	func (m *sessionTUI) cycleMachine() tea.Cmd {
98		if len(m.machineCycle) <= 1 {
99			return nil // nothing to cycle (only "all")
100		}
101		idx := 0
102		for i, e := range m.machineCycle {
103			if e.key == m.machineFilter {
104				idx = i
105				break
106			}
107		}
108		m.machineFilter = m.machineCycle[(idx+1)%len(m.machineCycle)].key
109		// Client-side re-filter of cached rows — same as the agent filter, in whichever view is active.
110		if m.mode == modeProjects && m.globalActive {
111			m.rebuildGlobalResults()
112			m.globalCursor = clampIndex(m.globalCursor, len(m.globalResults))
113			m.clampGlobalScroll()
114			return m.requestVisibleSnippets(modeProjects)
115		}
116		m.refilterCurrentAgent()
117		return m.requestVisibleSnippets(modeList)
118	}

120	// machineMatch reports whether a row passes the current machine filter. "local only" keeps local
121	// rows plus this machine's own cloud rows (its synced-then-pruned sessions); a specific remote
122	// deviceId keeps only that machine's cloud rows.
123	func (m *sessionTUI) machineMatch(s sessionindex.Session) bool {
124		switch m.machineFilter {
125		case "":
126			return true
127		case "local":
128			return !s.IsCloud || s.DeviceID == m.deviceID
129		default:
130			return s.IsCloud && s.DeviceID == m.machineFilter
131		}
132	}

185	// cloudFetchCmd lists a project's cloud-resumable sessions off the UI thread and converts them to
186	// index rows. agentIDByName resolves each row's display agent name back to a provider id.
187	func cloudFetchCmd(projectID string, agentIDByName map[string]string) tea.Cmd {

209	// cloudToSessions converts cloud session summaries to local index rows for blending. Rows whose
210	// agent can't be resolved to a known provider id are skipped — they can't be reconstructed/resumed
211	// here, so rendering them would only offer an action that fails.
212	// cloudTitle picks a cloud row's display title: the prompt-derived title synced in metadata (built
213	// by the same GenerateReadableName a local row uses, so it renders identically) when present, else
214	// the filename name. Older blobs synced before titles were stored have no metadata title and show
215	// the filename until they re-sync.
216	func cloudTitle(metaTitle, name string) string {
217		if metaTitle != "" {
218			return metaTitle
219		}
220		return name
221	}
222	
223	// firstNonEmpty returns the first non-empty string, or "" if all are empty. Used to pick a cloud
224	// row's real activity time (ended/started, from the duration worker) over the sync timestamp, so the
225	// row displays and sorts by when the session happened rather than when it was last pushed.
226	func firstNonEmpty(vals ...string) string {
227		for _, v := range vals {
228			if v != "" {
229				return v
230			}
231		}
232		return ""
233	}

235	func cloudToSessions(cs []cloud.CloudSession, agentIDByName map[string]string) []sessionindex.Session {
236		out := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, len(cs))
237		for _, c := range cs {
238			agentID, ok := agentIDByName[c.Metadata.AgentName]
239			if !ok {
240				slog.Debug("cloud resume: skipping session with unknown agent",
241					"agentName", c.Metadata.AgentName, "sessionId", c.ClientID)
242				continue
243			}
244			out = append(out, sessionindex.Session{
245				ProjectID:   c.ProjectID,
246				Agent:       agentID,
247				SessionID:   c.ClientID,
248				CreatedAt:   firstNonEmpty(c.StartedAt, c.CreatedAt),
249				UpdatedAt:   firstNonEmpty(c.EndedAt, c.StartedAt, c.UpdatedAt),
250				Name:        cloudTitle(c.Metadata.Title, c.Name),
251				IsCloud:     true,
252				DeviceID:    c.Metadata.DeviceID,
253				MachineName: c.Metadata.MachineName,
254			})
255		}
256		return out
257	}

261	// cloudPreviewMsg carries a cloud row's rendered markdown back to the model. seq matches the
262	// openPreview that requested it, so a result that arrives after the reader closed or moved on is
263	// dropped. On error, markdown is a short human-readable notice rendered in place of the content.
264	type cloudPreviewMsg struct {
265		seq      int
266		markdown string
267	}
268	
269	// cloudPreviewCmd fetches a cloud session's SessionData blob and renders it to markdown off the UI
270	// thread. It reuses the exact blob resume fetches and the same markdown generator the local preview
271	// uses, so a cloud row previews identically to its local counterpart.
272	func cloudPreviewCmd(s sessionindex.Session, seq int) tea.Cmd {
273		return func() tea.Msg {
274			raw, err := cloud.FetchSessionData(s.ProjectID, s.SessionID)
275			if err != nil {
276				slog.Debug("cloud preview: fetch failed", "sessionId", s.SessionID, "error", err)
277				return cloudPreviewMsg{seq: seq, markdown: "_(couldn't load this session from SpecStory Cloud)_"}
278			}
279			var data schema.SessionData
280			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &data); err != nil {
281				slog.Debug("cloud preview: parse failed", "sessionId", s.SessionID, "error", err)
282				return cloudPreviewMsg{seq: seq, markdown: "_(couldn't read this session's data)_"}
283			}
284			md, err := session.GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(&data, false, true)
285			if err != nil {
286				slog.Debug("cloud preview: render failed", "sessionId", s.SessionID, "error", err)
287				return cloudPreviewMsg{seq: seq, markdown: "_(couldn't render this session)_"}
288			}
289			return cloudPreviewMsg{seq: seq, markdown: md}
290		}
291	}
292	
293	// applyCloudPreview installs a cloud preview's markdown into the reader, but only if it's still the
294	// one being shown (seq matches and the reader is open) — otherwise the user has closed it or moved
295	// to another row and the result is stale.
296	func (m sessionTUI) applyCloudPreview(msg cloudPreviewMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
297		if !m.previewing || msg.seq != m.previewSeq {
298			return m, nil
299		}
300		m.reader.SetContent(renderGlamour(msg.markdown, m.width))
301		m.reader.GotoTop()
302		return m, nil
303	}

305	// cloudFetchForActiveCmd starts a cloud fetch for the active project when the user is cloud-
306	// eligible, marking the pending indicator; returns nil otherwise. Callers invoke it after changing

308	// blend in, mirroring the initial fetch on open.
309	func (m *sessionTUI) cloudFetchForActiveCmd() tea.Cmd {
310		if !m.cloudEligible {

317	// cloudToProjects converts cloud project summaries to project rows for the blended browser. A
318	// project with zero sessions is skipped: a workspace can exist in the cloud with no sessions (e.g.
319	// created on first push, its sessions since deleted), in which case last_session is null and its
320	// lastUpdated defaults to ~now server-side — it would float to the top of the recency sort as a
321	// phantom with nothing to resume.
322	func cloudToProjects(cs []cloud.CloudProject) []sessionindex.ProjectSummary {
323		out := make([]sessionindex.ProjectSummary, 0, len(cs))
324		for _, c := range cs {
325			if c.SessionCount == 0 {
326				continue
327			}
328			out = append(out, sessionindex.ProjectSummary{
329				ProjectID:    c.ID,
330				ProjectName:  c.Name,
331				Sessions:     c.SessionCount,
332				LastActivity: c.LastUpdated,
333				IsCloud:      true,
334			})
335		}
336		return out
337	}

339	// ---- cloud search (global search view) ----
340	
341	// cloudSearchDebounceDelay is the fire-on-pause window for cloud search: it only fires after this
342	// much keyboard silence. Local FTS stays per-keystroke (searchDebounceDelay); the cloud query is
343	// deliberately slower so a typed query makes 1-2 cloud requests, not one per keystroke.
344	const cloudSearchDebounceDelay = 600 * time.Millisecond
345	
346	// cloud search serves two views: the global cross-project search (modeProjects) and the project-
347	// scoped list search (modeList). kind routes a debounce/result to the right one; they share
348	// cloudSearchSeq since only one is ever active at a time.
349	type cloudSearchDebounceMsg struct {
350		seq  int
351		kind tuiMode
352	}
353	
354	type cloudSearchResultMsg struct {
355		seq      int
356		kind     tuiMode
357		sessions []sessionindex.Session
358		snippets map[string]string
359		err      error
360	}
361	
362	// cloudSearchDebounce schedules a fire-on-pause tick; on fire, the model checks the seq and cloud
363	// eligibility before actually querying (so only the last keystroke in a burst hits the network).
364	func cloudSearchDebounce(seq int, kind tuiMode) tea.Cmd {
365		return tea.Tick(cloudSearchDebounceDelay, func(time.Time) tea.Msg {
366			return cloudSearchDebounceMsg{seq: seq, kind: kind}
367		})
368	}
369	
370	// cloudSearchCmd runs the aligned cloud search off the UI thread and converts hits to index rows.
371	// projectID scopes the search to one project server-side ("" = all projects, for global search).
372	func cloudSearchCmd(query string, seq int, kind tuiMode, projectID string, agentIDByName map[string]string) tea.Cmd {
373		return func() tea.Msg {
374			hits, err := cloud.SearchCloudSessions(query, projectID)
375			if err != nil {
376				return cloudSearchResultMsg{seq: seq, kind: kind, err: err}
377			}
378			sessions, snippets := cloudSearchHitsToSessions(hits, agentIDByName)
379			return cloudSearchResultMsg{seq: seq, kind: kind, sessions: sessions, snippets: snippets}
380		}
381	}
382	
383	// cloudSearchHitsToSessions converts search hits to index rows (like cloudToSessions) and collects
384	// their server-highlighted snippets, keyed by FingerprintKey so the renderer finds them.
385	func cloudSearchHitsToSessions(
386		hits []cloud.CloudSearchHit, agentIDByName map[string]string,
387	) ([]sessionindex.Session, map[string]string) {
388		sessions := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, len(hits))
389		snippets := make(map[string]string, len(hits))
390		for _, h := range hits {
391			agentID, ok := agentIDByName[h.Metadata.AgentName]
392			if !ok {
393				slog.Debug("cloud search: skipping hit with unknown agent",
394					"agentName", h.Metadata.AgentName, "sessionId", h.ClientID)
395				continue
396			}
397			sessions = append(sessions, sessionindex.Session{
398				ProjectID:   h.ProjectID,
399				ProjectName: h.ProjectName,
400				Agent:       agentID,
401				SessionID:   h.ClientID,
402				CreatedAt:   firstNonEmpty(h.StartedAt, h.CreatedAt),
403				UpdatedAt:   firstNonEmpty(h.EndedAt, h.StartedAt, h.UpdatedAt),
404				Name:        cloudTitle(h.Metadata.Title, h.Name),
405				IsCloud:     true,
406				DeviceID:    h.Metadata.DeviceID,
407				MachineName: h.Metadata.MachineName,
408			})
409			if h.Snippet != "" {
410				snippets[sessionindex.FingerprintKey(agentID, h.ClientID)] = h.Snippet
411			}
412		}
413		return sessions, snippets
414	}
415	
416	// applyCloudSearchDebounce fires the actual cloud query only if this is still the latest request
417	// and cloud is eligible — otherwise it's a no-op (a newer keystroke superseded it, or the user
418	// isn't Pro/logged-in).
419	func (m sessionTUI) applyCloudSearchDebounce(msg cloudSearchDebounceMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
420		if msg.seq != m.cloudSearchSeq || !m.cloudEligible {
421			return m, nil
422		}
423		if msg.kind == modeList {
424			// Project-scoped list search: scope the cloud query to the active project server-side.
425			if !queryReady(m.searchQuery) {
426				return m, nil
427			}
428			m.cloudSearchPending = true
429			return m, cloudSearchCmd(m.searchQuery, msg.seq, modeList, m.projectID, m.agentIDByName)
430		}
431		// Global cross-project search: pass the current scope (globalScopeID; "" = all projects).
432		if !queryReady(m.globalQuery) {
433			return m, nil
434		}
435		m.cloudSearchPending = true
436		return m, cloudSearchCmd(m.globalQuery, msg.seq, modeProjects, m.globalScopeID, m.agentIDByName)
437	}

439	// applyCloudSearchResult merges a completed cloud search into the global results (dedup local-
440	// preferred, re-sorted by recency), preserving the selected row. Stale/failed responses degrade
441	// silently to local-only.
442	func (m sessionTUI) applyCloudSearchResult(msg cloudSearchResultMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
443		if msg.seq != m.cloudSearchSeq {
444			return m, nil // a newer query superseded this one
445		}
446		m.cloudSearchPending = false
447		if msg.err != nil {
448			slog.Debug("cloud search failed, showing local only", "error", msg.err)
449			return m, nil
450		}
451	
452		if msg.kind == modeList {
453			// Project-scoped list search: merge the cloud hits into m.filtered (deduped local-preferred,
454			// recency-sorted) via refilterCurrentAgent, preserving the selected row.
455			selID := ""
456			if sel := m.selected(); sel != nil {
457				selID = sel.SessionID
458			}
459			m.listCloud = msg.sessions
460			m.listCloudSnippets = msg.snippets
461			m.refilterCurrentAgent()
462			m.cursor = indexOfSession(m.filtered, selID)
463			m.clampScroll()
464			return m, nil
465		}
466	
467		selID := ""
468		if sel := m.globalSelected(); sel != nil {
469			selID = sel.SessionID
470		}
471		m.globalCloud = msg.sessions
472		m.globalCloudSnippets = msg.snippets
473		m.rebuildGlobalResults()
474		m.globalCursor = indexOfSession(m.globalResults, selID)
475		m.clampGlobalScroll()
476		return m, nil
477	}
478	
479	// rebuildGlobalResults derives the visible global-search list by merging the local FTS results with
480	// the cloud search hits (dedup local-preferred, recency-sorted) and applying the agent + machine
481	// filters. Cursor management is the caller's — this only rebuilds the list and the machine ring.
482	func (m *sessionTUI) rebuildGlobalResults() {
483		src := m.globalLocal
484		if len(m.globalCloud) > 0 {
485			src = mergeCloudRows(m.globalLocal, m.globalCloud)
486		}
487		out := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, len(src))
488		for _, s := range src {
489			// Project scope is applied server-side now (both the local FTS and the cloud query are scoped
490			// by globalScopeID), so both sources already contain only in-scope rows here.
491			if m.agentFilter != "" && s.Agent != m.agentFilter {
492				continue
493			}
494			if !m.machineMatch(s) {
495				continue
496			}
497			out = append(out, s)
498		}
499		m.globalResults = out
500		m.rebuildMachineCycle()
501	}
502	
503	// applyCloudEligibility records the eligibility result, sets the appropriate nudge, and — when
504	// eligible — starts the first cloud fetch for the active (home) project's sessions and the user's
505	// cloud project list (for the blended all-projects browser).
506	func (m sessionTUI) applyCloudEligibility(msg cloudEligibilityMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
507		m.cloudChecked = true
508		m.cloudEligible = msg.loggedIn && msg.pro
509		switch {
510		case !msg.loggedIn:
511			m.cloudNudge = cloudNudgeLogin
512		case !msg.pro:
513			m.cloudNudge = cloudNudgeUpgrade
514		default:
515			m.cloudNudge = ""
516		}
517		if !m.cloudEligible {
518			return m, nil
519		}
520		m.cloudPending = true
521		cmds := []tea.Cmd{
522			cloudFetchCmd(m.projectID, m.agentIDByName),
523			cloudProjectsFetchCmd(),
524		}
525		// Opened straight into search with a pre-seeded query (`specstory search foo`): now that we know
526		// we're eligible, kick the cloud search too (the per-keystroke path only fires on later typing).
527		if m.globalActive && queryReady(m.globalQuery) {
528			m.cloudSearchSeq++
529			m.cloudSearchPending = true

558		m.cloudPending = false

570		selID := ""

585	// mergeCloudRows blends cloud rows into a local list: dedup by (agent, session_id) with the LOCAL
586	// copy preferred (it resumes instantly and offline), then re-sort the union by recency
587	// (UpdatedAt desc). The TUI model never sorts its input, so cloud rows must be interleaved by time
588	// here rather than appended.
589	func mergeCloudRows(local, cloudRows []sessionindex.Session) []sessionindex.Session {
590		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(local))
591		for _, s := range local {
592			seen[sessionindex.FingerprintKey(s.Agent, s.SessionID)] = true
593		}
594		merged := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, len(local)+len(cloudRows))
595		merged = append(merged, local...)
596		for _, c := range cloudRows {
597			if seen[sessionindex.FingerprintKey(c.Agent, c.SessionID)] {
598				continue // local wins
599			}
600			merged = append(merged, c)
601		}
602		sort.SliceStable(merged, func(i, j int) bool {
603			return sessionUpdatedTime(merged[i]).After(sessionUpdatedTime(merged[j]))
604		})
605		return merged
606	}
607	
608	// sessionUpdatedTime parses a row's UpdatedAt for recency sorting. Local and cloud timestamps are
609	// both RFC3339 but differ in precision/offset (e.g. "…Z" vs "…+00:00" with microseconds), so a raw
610	// string compare would misorder them — parse to a real time instead. Unparseable → zero (sorts last).
611	func sessionUpdatedTime(s sessionindex.Session) time.Time {
612		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s.UpdatedAt); err == nil {
613			return t
614		}
615		return time.Time{}
616	}
617	
618	// mergeCloudProjects blends cloud-only projects into the local project list: dedup by project_id
619	// with the local rollup preferred (it has the real per-agent chips and resumes offline), then
620	// re-sort the union by recency (LastActivity desc). Same shape as mergeCloudRows for sessions.
621	func mergeCloudProjects(local, cloudProjects []sessionindex.ProjectSummary) []sessionindex.ProjectSummary {
622		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(local))
623		for _, p := range local {
624			seen[p.ProjectID] = true
625		}
626		merged := make([]sessionindex.ProjectSummary, 0, len(local)+len(cloudProjects))
627		merged = append(merged, local...)
628		for _, c := range cloudProjects {
629			if seen[c.ProjectID] {
630				continue // local wins
631			}
632			merged = append(merged, c)
633		}
634		sort.SliceStable(merged, func(i, j int) bool {
635			return projectActivityTime(merged[i]).After(projectActivityTime(merged[j]))
636		})
637		return merged
638	}
639	
640	// projectActivityTime parses a project's LastActivity for recency sorting (RFC3339, like
641	// sessionUpdatedTime). Unparseable → zero (sorts last).
642	func projectActivityTime(p sessionindex.ProjectSummary) time.Time {
643		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, p.LastActivity); err == nil {
644			return t
645		}
646		return time.Time{}
647	}

Build passes and lint is clean. Here's what I changed and why:

## Changes

**1. `pkg/cmd/session_tui_cloud.go`**

- Changed the upgrade nudge copy to `"u - Upgrade to Pro to search & resume sessions from your other machines"` so the `u` hotkey is discoverable inline (matching how the footer advertises its keys).
- Added `checkoutURL()` — builds `<cloud-base>/checkout?plan=pro` off `cloud.GetAPIBaseURL()`, which honours `--cloud-url` / `SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL`. So a dev/staging build opens its own checkout, not production.
- Added `upgradeCmd()` — returns a `tea.Cmd` that opens the checkout page via the existing `openBrowser` helper (from `login.go`), but **only** when the upgrade nudge is showing. It's a no-op otherwise, so `u` stays inert for users who are already Pro or logged out.

**2. `pkg/cmd/session_tui.go` + `pkg/cmd/session_tui_browser.go`**

- Wired `case "u"` into the three navigation key handlers where the nudge is visible: `updateList`, `updateProjects`, and `updateGlobalResults`. I deliberately did **not** wire it into the search-input handlers (`updateSearch`, `updateGlobalSearch`, `updateProjectSearch`) because `u` there is a literal character being typed into a query box.

## Two decisions worth flagging

- **Scoped to the upgrade nudge only.** The `u` key does nothing when the *login* nudge (`cloudNudgeLogin`) is showing, since "log in" is a different action (device-login flow, not checkout). I left that copy unprefixed. If you'd like a parallel `l - Log in…` hotkey wired to the login flow, I can add it — say the word.
- **Opening a browser is a side effect** run through a `tea.Cmd` (off the UI thread) rather than inline, consistent with how the rest of the TUI does async work. Failures degrade silently to a debug log, matching the cloud-resume "never block the user" pattern.

One thing I couldn't verify without a live not-Pro-but-logged-in cloud session: that the `/checkout?plan=pro` route exists and accepts that query param on the Worker side. Do you want me to confirm the route shape against specstory-sync, or is `/checkout?plan=pro` already the correct path?

## What I changed in `pkg/cmd/skills.go`

**1. Split the access check into two pieces** so the interactive command and the subcommands can behave differently while sharing one source of truth:

- `skillsAccess()` — returns `(loggedIn, entitled, err)`.
- `ensureSkillsAccess()` — still the strict gate for the non-interactive subcommands (`list`, `install`, etc.); returns the same style of error as before (I did tidy its message to use the active cloud base URL rather than a hardcoded `cloud.specstory.com`).

**2. The interactive `specstory skills` (no subcommand) now branches:**

- Not logged in → same "run `specstory login`" error as before.
- Logged in but not Pro → instead of the red `ERROR` block, it calls `promptSkillsUpgrade()`.
- Entitled → unchanged (opens the TUI).

**3. `promptSkillsUpgrade()`** prints:

```

  Upgrade to SpecStory Pro
  for automatic skills generation from your SpecStory Cloud agent sessions.

  Press u to upgrade, or any other key to quit:
```

`u`/`U` opens the browser to `checkoutURL()` — the **same** `<cloud-base>/checkout?plan=pro` the resume TUI's `u` hotkey uses. Any other key quits. It returns `nil` (declining isn't an error, so no `ERROR` block).

**4. `readSingleKey()`** reads one keypress without Enter, using the already-present `golang.org/x/term`: raw mode for a single read on a real terminal (restored immediately after), with a byte-read fallback when stdin isn't a TTY so piped/test invocations still work.
